mapper.sql: id, record_id AS recordId, user_id AS userId, model_id AS modelId, model, api_key_id AS apiKeyId, api_key_name AS apiKeyName, platform, stream, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, total_tokens AS totalTokens, usage_source AS usageSource, total_latency_ms AS totalLatencyMs, create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: SELECT , user_message_id AS userMessageId, assistant_message_id AS assistantMessageId, first_token_latency_ms AS firstTokenLatencyMs, streaming_duration_ms AS streamingDurationMs, tokens_per_second AS tokensPerSecond, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt FROM bedrock_ai_token_usage WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM bedrock_ai_token_usage
ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bedrock_ai_token_usage WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_tokens), 0) FROM bedrock_ai_token_usage WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) FROM bedrock_ai_token_usage WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) FROM bedrock_ai_token_usage WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bedrock_ai_token_usage WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_tokens), 0) FROM bedrock_ai_token_usage WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT model, COUNT(1) AS callCount, IFNULL(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens FROM bedrock_ai_token_usage WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY model_id, model ORDER BY callCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(1) AS callCount, IFNULL(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens FROM bedrock_ai_token_usage WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY statDate ASC
